technical.lead: FMRB EO: classified-annex response clock at day 2, T-4 to May 22
technical.body: The Frontier Model Review Board executive order held its post-briefing Sunday phase with the ten-business-day classified-annex response clock running into its second calendar day. A Sunday Lawfare weekend procedural note reported that the Senate Cyber Subcommittee's classified-annex follow-up question set, transmitted Friday to the eight-witness slate, has drawn an early acknowledgement of receipt from NIST Director Locascio's office and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency Director's office, with substantive responses not due until the ten-business-day clock expires and none filed over the business-quiet weekend. A Sunday Just Security weekend reading reaffirmed Saturday's analysis that the Friday unclassified summary memo's no-objection finding on the per-state attorney-general consultation pathway and the AISI cyber-evaluation reciprocity 120-day placement window removes the principal cited signing-window blocker, while White House OSTP held the line that the order remains in interagency review with no signing window before May 22. The House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on Communications and Technology confirmed its parallel 30-day technical-review joint-resolution draft text continues circulating for markup scheduling, with no weekend markup notice posted.

technical.lead: Cerebras logs 4th consolidation day; sell-side holds $185-235 band
technical.body: Cerebras CBRS spent the Sunday market closure in a sell-side weekend hold-steady with no fresh tape, the equity having printed four consecutive consolidation days into Friday's $198.60 second-trading-week close. A Sunday BEAMSTART weekend coverage note reported the five-desk analyst spread carrying forward unchanged from Saturday — Bernstein's $185 Market-Perform floor, Morgan Stanley's $192 target with the upside-scenario probability at 41 percent, Wells Fargo Securities Buy at $208, Jefferies Outperform at $225, and UBS Neutral at $205 — leaving the stock bracketed inside a roughly $185-to-$235 band heading into the new trading week. Institutional-buyside cumulative net position held near 37 percent of float with no weekend macro catalyst. A Sunday Datacenter Dynamics weekend wire reported the Saudi Aramco Digital MoU close holding its late-Q2 2026 window and the Saudi PIF contingent-secondary discussion staying inside its 10-21 day execution window, with the desk preview cohort flagging Monday's open as the first re-rating opportunity for the four-day consolidation base.

technical.lead: n8n CVE-2026-21858 day-17 scan eases to ~1,920; T-4 to deadline
technical.body: The Shadowserver day-seventeen n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare) Sunday scan extended the post-Monday-spike taper through the second weekend day as the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline reached T-minus-four business days. Internet-exposed pre-1.121.0 instances continued the descent to approximately 1,920 (down from Saturday's 2,180), with the US cohort easing to roughly 605 and the India cohort to approximately 325, and the residual long-tail unpatched share falling to about 14 percent. Censys honeypot telemetry reported exploitation attempts easing further to approximately 1.4x baseline at the Sunday 09:00 UTC mark — consistent with the commodity-tier exploit-kit volume continuing its scheduled weekend taper, down from Saturday's 1.6x. CISA's Sunday KEV-catalog weekend note restated that the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline now sits at T-minus-four business days, and the CISA federal-civilian operational directive incorporating the eleven-CVE Trail of Bits agent-loader taxonomy, having cleared the OMB publication queue Friday, remains on track for publication early in the new week.

technical.lead: Claude Code 3.0 day-10: ~29,180 skills, 64 gated tenants hold
technical.body: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 day-ten registry telemetry showed a Sunday continuation of the second-week growth-rate normalization, with the daily gain holding in the sub-7-percent band over the second business-quiet weekend day. Anthropic's Sunday operations note reported the sandboxed-skill registry counting roughly 29,180 published skills (up from 27,640 Saturday, about +5.6 percent — a fourth consecutive sub-7-percent reading), with approximately 2.58M skill installs across the tenth 24 hours and auto-quarantined Mythos-class skills reaching 65. Anthropic reported the Mythos-Preview gated-tenant cohort holding at 64 enterprise customers with no weekend signings, consistent with the business-quiet Sunday cadence. A Sunday Simon Willison note documented that the open-source verification harness's deterministic per-tenant attestation-log audit trail continues to reproduce across all 64 gated tenants, with cross-tenant compositional safety checks holding under 55 seconds following Saturday's parallel-verification optimization — confirming the Verifiable Per-Tenant Capability Attestation paper's demonstration cycle holds at three-continent multi-tenant scale through the full weekend, with the gated cohort's Continental European and Nordic defense base unchanged ahead of an expected resumption of enterprise signings in the new week.

technical.lead: Sunday arxiv 2605.07412 closes loader-verification line empirically
technical.body: A Sunday arxiv release (2605.07412) extended the Saturday unified five-surface loader-verification model with an empirical evaluation note, supplying a reproduction study that runs the consolidated Python and Rust reference implementations against the eleven catalogued agent-loader CVE patterns and reports a full pass on the compositional safety theorems for all five mitigation surfaces. The paper, positioned as a companion to the Saturday 2605.07241 framework rather than a fresh model, adds a per-surface micro-benchmark showing the load-time signed-checkpoint and manifest-allowlist validation paths add a low single-digit-percentage overhead to agent cold-start, and frames the result as a research input the framework maintainer cohort can cite when shipping the five-surface mitigation as a mid-June default. A Sunday Simon Willison weekend note characterized the paper as the loader-verification line's empirical close — pairing Saturday's formal model with a reproducible measurement so the mid-June framework releases have both a verified reference and a measured overhead budget. A Sunday andrew.ooo weekend reading noted the paper's reproduction harness is mirrored alongside the DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft consolidated reference-implementation index.
